knowledge:
- key_parameters: cyto_feature=A string specifying the chromosome and region of interest (e.g., "chr20(q11.1-q13.1)") ;; Counts=A matrix of normalized scRNA-seq counts ;; normalization=Logical indicating whether to normalize the counts ;; qt_cutoff=Quantile cutoff to filter out cells with very low expression (e.g., 0.99 filters out cells expressing in < 1% of cells) ;; int_counts=The processed count matrix output from GetExprCountCyto ;; cyto_type=Type of cytogenetic alteration, either "del" (deletion) or "amp" (amplification) ;; cyto_p=Prior probability or expected proportion of altered cells based on cytogenetics data
- alternatives: copyKAT=Preferred for solid tumors (e.g., lung cancer, breast cancer) ;; inferCNV=Preferred for solid tumors (e.g., lung cancer, breast cancer)
- when_to_use: Appropriate for analyzing scRNA-seq data from patients with hematologic malignancies (such as MDS and AML) where a subset of cells carries known cytogenetic alterations (local deletions or amplifications).
- pitfalls: Do not use if the patient has normal cytogenetics (e.g., 46,XY[20]) or if all cells are altered (e.g., 46,XY,del(20)[25]) as there is no mixture to classify ;; For complex cytogenetics, analyze features one by one (e.g., start with amplification, then analyze deletion) ;; Increase qt_cutoff if the total number of genes within the target region is small.

workflows.name: part_cnv_standard
workflows.intent: Identify locally aneuploid cells using the standard partCNV EM algorithm.
workflows.stages: 1. Retrieve genomic coordinates for the cytogenetics feature ;; 2. Subset and filter the count matrix ;; 3. Run the EM algorithm for cell classification
workflows.code:
res <- GetCytoLocation(cyto_feature = "chr20(q11.1-q13.1)")
GEout <- GetExprCountCyto(cytoloc_output = res, Counts = as.matrix(SimData), normalization = TRUE, qt_cutoff = 0.99)
pcout <- partCNV(int_counts = GEout$ProcessedCount,
                 cyto_type = "del",
                 cyto_p = 0.40)

workflows.name: part_cnvh_hmm
workflows.intent: Identify locally aneuploid cells using partCNVH which integrates a Hidden Markov Model for feature selection.
workflows.stages: 1. Retrieve genomic coordinates for the cytogenetics feature ;; 2. Subset and filter the count matrix ;; 3. Run the EM algorithm with HMM feature selection
workflows.code:
res <- GetCytoLocation(cyto_feature = "chr20(q11.1-q13.1)")
GEout <- GetExprCountCyto(cytoloc_output = res, Counts = as.matrix(SimData), normalization = TRUE, qt_cutoff = 0.99)
pcHout <- partCNVH(int_counts = GEout$ProcessedCount,
                 cyto_type = "del",
                 cyto_p = 0.40)
